summary: Frontend-only validation of 3 CMS/UI features on Xaluca Tours preview. Feature 1 (Tours video section): section, card, iframe (id nzD3e3Qr7g8), controls=0, 16:9 ratio, correct order between EditorialIntro and RegionsSection, all custom control test-ids present, and section also renders at /en/tours — ALL PASS. Feature 2 (CategoryImageCarousel editable in image edit mode): editable overlay appears on the CURRENTLY VISIBLE slide with slot id like 'home.cat.<slug>.image-<i>', clicking the Editar button opens [role=dialog] for that slot, auto-rotation paused while editMode=ON, prev/next arrows (data-edit-allow=true) advance the active slide and the new active slide becomes the editable one — ALL PASS. Feature 3 (Per-page slot namespacing): hero/day/gallery slot ids on /viajes/marrakech_ergchebbi/programa_4n_5d are fully prefixed with that page path; the equivalent slots on /viajes/ergchebbi_marrakech/programa_4n_5d are different and prefixed with their own path. Zero overlap between the two programs' day_image and day_gallery slots — ALL PASS. Images render correctly on both pages.
critical_code_review_comments: ToursVideoSection: the iframe has no title attribute and the overlay 'stage-toggle' button stacks above the iframe (z-20) — this is intentional for hiding YT chrome, but accessibility could benefit from an aria-label/title on the iframe and a keyboard-navigable focus order on the custom controls.

CategoryImageCarousel: pointerEvents on the active slide div computes to 'none' under getComputedStyle in our test (likely due to Tailwind class ordering). The functional behaviour still works because the inner overlay/edit button has its own pointer-events-auto, but verifying the Tailwind class combo (pointer-events-auto vs pointer-events-none in template literal) is worthwhile — current code: `${i === active ? 'pointer-events-auto' : 'pointer-events-none'}` is on its own line so it should override; minor lint nit only.

Feature 1 — in an automated headless environment, the center play button click did not actually flip 'playing' state (YT.Player may not honour playVideo without a user gesture). Functional UI-level wiring is correct (togglePlay handler is bound, mute toggle clicked without error, pause/play toggles render the center button back); flagging only as a known limitation of headless YouTube IFrame API.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview URL: https://morocco-trips-2.preview.emergentagent.com. Edit mode is global and persists across navigations within the same tab — read aria-pressed of [data-testid=header-edit-mode-toggle] before clicking. For the carousel arrow/dot test, use JS .click() inside page.evaluate to bypass any overlay z-index issues. For Feature 3 verification, scrolling the program page fully (yields lazy-mounted DayGallery components) is required before collecting all editable-overlay testids. Programs differ structurally — one program may have day-galleries while another doesn't; that's not a bug.
rca of the issue: n/a — no defects observed in this iteration.
